appearance_facts.fact: A single blue line with black circular markers descends across the plot from the 2005 point to the 2014 point.
The 2005 marker is the highest point on the series, positioned near the top of the y-axis scale.
The 2014 marker is the lowest point on the series, positioned near the bottom of the y-axis scale.
Markers are evenly spaced for each year from 2005 through 2014, showing a continuous downward trend.

printed_facts.fact: Vertical axis is labeled 'Temperature (°C)' with tick values 0, 5, 10, 15, 20.
Horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' with tick labels 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014.

public_definitions: Task: 'Review the 2005-2014 temperature record and choose the handling route based on whether the period-wide change is large enough to require targeted follow-up or ordinary enough to remain on routine monitoring.'
Option 1: 'Route the 2005-2014 temperature change to substantial-change follow-up'
Option 2: 'Keep the 2005-2014 temperature change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation'
Option 3: 'Route the temperature record to archive and background filing'
Companion field 'Routing criterion': 'Whether the period-wide temperature change warrants targeted follow-up'
uncertain: No explicit numerical threshold is printed on the chart or form to define the boundary between 'substantial change' and 'ordinary variation'; the decision relies on interpreting the magnitude of the 23.9°C to 10.1°C change.
